about_the_game:
Welcome to Orange Life – a weird, chaotic, and strangely peaceful slice of something bigger.
Right now, your journey is just beginning. There’s no huge open world yet, no cars (sorry!), and only one mission to guide you. But that’s all you need to dive in.

Explore strange buildings that feel both empty and alive. Play around with elevators, lights, and random objects. Swim through the calm water like it’s your only escape. Nothing makes perfect sense—and that’s kind of the point.

This is a limited early experience, a raw look into what Orange Life is becoming. It’s about freedom, curiosity, and the joy of messing with a world that doesn’t care if you’re doing it “right.” There’s no big plot (yet). No rules. Just vibes.

More is coming. But for now, take it slow, look around, and enjoy the weirdness.

short_description: Dive into the unpredictable world of Orange Life. Swim, ride elevators, and unlock the power to throw absurd amounts of oranges. Just don’t expect a car—yet. It’s a buggy, early look at what’s to come, full of personality and chaos.
